title: Prowler Sound
blurb: Daniel Pemberton's snarling electronic drone announces the Prowler in Into the Spider-Verse, and TikTok immediately promoted it to the official audio of a menacing arrival. What makes it so effective is that it is barely a melody at all — it is a texture with intent, and it makes anything walking into frame look like it has already decided something. Use it for villain entrances, gym walk-ins, and cats appearing at three in the morning with the eyes of a creature that has made plans. Still genuinely unsettling.
origin: Uncle Aaron's Prowler theme from Into the Spider-Verse, TikTok's menace sound.
